summary: Verified the V1 Connect / Transcript persistence fix end-to-end at the API layer (all 10 pytest tests pass) and confirmed backend env / log evidence. Frontend Playwright run was BLOCKED by a preview-environment issue: the public preview URL https://tasck-live-demo-1.preview.emergentagent.com/ does NOT serve the React bundle (root '/' returns only the Emergent telemetry chrome with 0 data-testid nodes and 0 React JS scripts in document.scripts). This blocks any UI automation, so UI persistence/dedup/save-spam assertions were not exercised by Playwright. The fix's behavioural contract is, however, fully exercised by the backend regression and the seed data shows the correct ordering, persistence, dedup-by-id, and analyze-all transcript_count progression (4 then 5) in backend logs.

minor.issue: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in preview is out of credits, so analyze-all returns analysis_source='honest_fallback' with analysis_model=''. Per task brief this is acceptable: status 200, 8-field bundle still present, no 5xx. Production model usage cannot be asserted in this preview; verify in prod that analysis_model == 'claude-sonnet-4-5' once billing is restored.
No DELETE /api/v3/meetings/{id} endpoint exists. Tests had to clean up via direct Mongo. Worth adding for testability.

integration_issues.issue: Root URL and /v3/admin/business-cases/.../connect/schedule both return an HTML document of ~11.6KB whose document.scripts contains ONLY posthog/emergent-main.js — NO React bundle (no /static/js/*.js). Body innerText is just 'Made with Emergent'. No console errors are emitted because no JS runs. This blocks all Playwright UI testing. Frontend supervisor logs say 'webpack compiled successfully' so build is fine — the ingress/proxy is not forwarding /static/* to port 3000 or index.html is stale. Action: main agent should investigate the ingress route for /static/* or rebuild + re-deploy the CRA bundle.

action_items: Investigate why preview ingress is not serving the React bundle (no /static/js scripts on the served index.html). All UI automation is blocked until this is resolved.
After bundle issue is fixed, re-run the same flow via Playwright to validate UI hydration (4 then 5 editors), F5 dedup, and the no-duplicate-POST-spam invariant on save.
Consider adding a DELETE /api/v3/meetings/{id} endpoint for test cleanup and ops housekeeping.
Optional: when analysis_source='honest_fallback', set rec.analysis_model = ALIGNMENT_ANALYZER_MODEL anyway so UI can show 'claude-sonnet-4-5 (fallback)' rather than empty string.
critical_code_review_comments: V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js (4159 lines) is far above the 700-line guideline. The persistence fix (lines 1001-1035) is correct, but the file desperately needs to be split per phase (Connect, Frame, Plan, Delivery, Reporting).

saveConnectTranscriptSessions in saveTranscriptSessions / runCombinedAnalysis re-uploads ALL existing transcripts on each Analyze All click (one transcript POST per session). For sessions with a meetingId it still calls v3UploadMeetingTranscript with the same content — a quiet write amplification. Consider short-circuiting when content is unchanged.
v3_routes.py at 9997 lines is the same scaling problem; per iter21 review, splitting analyze-all + alignment helpers into v3_alignment.py would make this safer.
honest_fallback path in analyze-all currently returns analysis_model=''. UI shows 'Analyzer source' but lacks the configured fallback model name — minor UX gap.

loadMeetings sort by call_date || scheduled_for || created_at compares strings via localeCompare. As long as all timestamps are ISO-8601 this is fine, but mixed formats (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DD' vs ISO) would sort wrong. Document the invariant.

success_rate.frontend: 0% — blocked: preview ingress not serving the React bundle

test_credentials: Not required — backend admin v3 routes are unprotected in preview. Note: /admin/* (V1) IS protected by ProtectedRoute admin role, so UI testing must use /v3/admin/* (which renders the same V3BusinessCaseConnectSchedule component).
seed_data_creation: Test creates 4 (then 5) v3 business_call meetings on the seeded business case bc-472329ed4c, uploads transcripts, then cleans them up via direct Mongo (db.v3_meetings.delete_many on the tracked ids). Also performed a one-time housekeeping cleanup of 10 leftover TEST_ meetings from earlier iterations to leave bc-472329ed4c at 0 business_call meetings post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend persistence + dedup + analyze-all flow is GREEN. Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_connect_transcript_persistence.py to regress. UI test is pending the preview-bundle fix; once root '/' renders the LandingPage with React-mounted content, drive the flow at /v3/admin/business-cases/bc-472329ed4c/connect/schedule using the data-testids in V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js: connect-add-transcript-btn, connect-transcript-content-<sessionId>, connect-analyze-all-btn, connect-analysis-results. Do NOT use /admin/business-cases/.../connect/schedule — that path is gated by ProtectedRoute('admin') and will Navigate to '/' for unauthenticated runs. ALIGNMENT_ANALYZER_MODEL is correctly set to claude-sonnet-4-5 in /app/backend/.env line 16. analyze-all returns analysis_source='honest_fallback' in preview because Anthropic billing is out — this is expected and not a regression.
rca of the issue: Backend: previous agent's fix in V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js lines 1004-1029 (filter business_call, sort by date ascending via localeCompare, de-dup by meeting id with a Set, then setTranscriptSessions(uniqueMeetings.map(...)) instead of [businessCallMeetings[0]]) is verified correct by 10 black-box backend tests: 4 transcripts persist, refetch returns 4 unique ids, appending a 5th does not drop the previous 4, analyze-all backend log shows transcript_count=4 then transcript_count=5 sequentially, and the response is 200 with the alignment-snapshot 8-field bundle. ALIGNMENT_ANALYZER_MODEL env confirmed = claude-sonnet-4-5. Frontend block: preview proxy returning HTML without /static/js bundle — outside this testing run's scope to repair.
